messages:
maria_finance: Heads up — got a customer report (ZephyrCorp) that their March invoice is missing the GPU surcharge line for reserved capacity and they received two invoices with the same number (INV-2023-03-927). Can someone take a quick look?

jake_billing: Yikes. I see a failed job in the invoice generator around 2023-03-31 02:12 UTC. billing-bot posted an error then.

billing-bot: invoice_gen: error generating invoice for account=zephyrcorp tenant_id=tc_77891 invoice_id=INV-2023-03-927 error=missing_lineitems context=usage_aggregation

sylvia_ops: Adding logs — looks like the reserved_capacity_surcharge aggregator returned empty for that tenant for that run. Possibly a timezone/aggregation-window mismatch.

dan_sre: Paging the batch job logs now. Ran a quick grep: ``ERROR: aggregation window overlap for tenant tc_77891, window_end=2023-03-31T00:00:00Z``. That could explain missing surcharge if metrics were attributed to the previous day.

jake_billing: On the duplicate invoice: I see two invoice records with same invoice_id in DB but different internal run_ids. One run got a partial write then retried. The retry didn't clean up the partial so the UI exported both PDFs.

emily_cs: Customer is upset — they were charged the compute and embeddings lines but the reserved surcharge impacts their committed discount. Can we confirm whether they were overcharged?

jake_billing: Short answer: maybe. If surcharge omitted, their invoice might undercharge the surcharge (so undercharged), but the duplicated invoice means they could have been billed twice if both went to payment. Need to check payment status.

sylvia_ops: I'll re-run the aggregation for that tenant for the affected window in dry-run mode: ``./tools/agg_run --tenant tc_77891 --start 2023-03-30T00:00:00Z --end 2023-03-31T00:00:00Z --dry``

dan_sre: Ran it — dry-run shows reserved_capacity_surcharge=USD 1,250.00 and the invoice line is present now. That confirms omission in the original run.

jake_billing: OK. Action plan: 1) mark the duplicate invoice export as void (so it won't be auto-payed) 2) fix the partial-write cleanup so a retry doesn't leave a duplicate invoice row 3) regenerate the corrected invoice with the surcharge and send to the customer with an explanation + apology and a reconciling credit if needed.

emily_cs: Please cc me on the customer message. Also request a hold on automatic payment retries until we confirm this is resolved.

sylvia_ops: Root cause hypothesis: batch aggregator encountered a midnight-window boundary and returned empty for that tenant because their reserved usage was recorded at 23:59:59 in local tz vs UTC. I'll add a fix to extend the window by 1s and add unit tests.

jake_billing: I've created a ticket: FIN-4821 "invoice generator: partial-write causes duplicate invoice_id and missing surcharge line". Assigning to billing-engine. Will block retries by setting invoice_retry_enabled=false for the affected run ids.

emily_cs: Thanks. Can we also produce a list of customers who had invoice runs between 2023-03-31T00:00:00Z and 2023-03-31T00:05:00Z so CS can proactively check?

sylvia_ops: On it. Querying.. ``select invoice_id, tenant_id, status from invoices where created_at between '2023-03-31T00:00:00Z' and '2023-03-31T00:05:00Z'``

dan_sre: Quick findings: 7 invoices flagged with partial_write=true, 3 of those had duplicate exports. Listing will be pushed to #finance-private.

jake_billing: ETA for customer outreach + corrected invoice: EOD today if no blockers. Engineering will push the cleanup patch in the next deploy (target 14:00 UTC).

emily_cs: Copy — I'll draft the customer note and wait for the corrected invoice before sending. Include offer for a one-time credit if they were double-charged. :pray:

maria_finance: Appreciate the quick triage. Please add postmortem notes once the patch is live. Also log the refund/credit path so accounting can reconcile.

billing-bot: deploy: billing-engine v3.12.4-patch1 scheduled to deploy at 14:00 UTC. Changelog: fix(partial-write): ensure idempotent invoice record creation; fix(aggregator): expand window by 1s for reserved_capacity calculations

sylvia_ops: I'll follow up after the deploy and confirm regenerated invoices match expected amounts.

emily_cs: Thx everyone. Keep me posted and ping if customer asks for immediate escalation.
